perks.name: A Nurse's Calling
perks.current_effect: Reveals the Auras of Survivors who are healing or being healed within 28/30/32 m.
perks.plain_english_summary: See Survivors while they perform a healing interaction nearby, including when healthy.
activation_requirements: A Survivor must be healing or being healed.
That Survivor must be within the current tier's 28/30/32 m range.
deactivation_conditions: The Aura reveal ends when the healing interaction stops or the Survivor leaves range.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reads the Auras of Survivors in healing interactions within 28/30/32 m; no longer requires the target to be injured.
special_interactions: Does not reveal Survivors who are Mending or Snapping Out of It.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Expanded Aura reading to any Survivor in a healing interaction, regardless of Health State.

perks.verification_notes: The live values and scope match the current perk page and the official 10.1.0 notes. The 10.1.2a live-notes listing contains no later perk change.

perks.name: Agitation
perks.current_effect: While carrying a Survivor, increases carrying speed by 6/12/18% and increases the Terror Radius by 12 m.
perks.plain_english_summary: Carry Survivors faster, at the cost of a larger Terror Radius while carrying them.
activation_requirements: The Killer must be carrying a Survivor.
deactivation_conditions: Both effects end when the Killer is no longer carrying a Survivor.
perks.hook_interactions: The carrying speed bonus applies while transporting a Survivor to a Hook; it does not increase the Hooking action speed.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Standardized the Terror Radius increase at +12 m across all tiers; live carrying Haste values are 6/12/18%.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: While carrying a Survivor, Haste is proposed to increase to 14/16/18% from 6/12/18%; the +12 m Terror Radius remains.

perks.verification_notes: The current wiki page places 10.2.0 PTB values in its lead description; those values are excluded from current_effect and tier values. Official 10.2.0 PTB notes confirm the proposed tier update. The wiki also mentions an undocumented 8.7.0 Haste indicator; this is a UI change and is not treated as the latest balance change.

perks.name: Alien Instinct
perks.current_effect: Whenever you hook a Survivor, reveals for 8 seconds the Aura of the farthest Survivor from your location who is Injured, and inflicts Oblivious on that Survivor for 40/50/60 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: After a Hook, find the farthest injured Survivor and make them Oblivious.
activation_requirements: Hook a Survivor.
At least one other Survivor must be in the Injured State; the effect selects the farthest one from the Killer's current location.
deactivation_conditions: The Aura reveal ends after 8 seconds.
Oblivious ends after 40/50/60 seconds.
perks.hook_interactions: A Survivor hook triggers the perk.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals only the farthest Injured Survivor's Aura for 8 seconds.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased Aura reveal duration from 5 to 8 seconds and Oblivious duration from 16/18/20 to 40/50/60 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The official 8.6.0 patch notes explicitly confirm both listed buffs; the current page matches those live values.

perks.name: All-Shaking Thunder
perks.current_effect: After falling from a height, increases Lunge Attack range by 75% for 15/20/25 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: A fall gives your next Lunge Attacks extra range for a short window.
activation_requirements: The Killer must fall from a height.
deactivation_conditions: The increased Lunge Attack range ends after 15/20/25 seconds.
duration: 15/20/25 seconds after falling from a height.
perks.basic_attack_or_special_attack_restricti: The bonus applies to Lunge Attacks; the perk does not state a Basic Attack-only trigger.
special_interactions: The perk plays an activation sound cue audible to all Players in the Trial.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased duration from 8/12/16 to 15/20/25 seconds; the +75% Lunge Attack range and 5-second cooldown remain.

perks.verification_notes: The official 9.2.0 notes confirm the current duration buff, and the current wiki perk page supplies the other effect values and sound-cue note.

perks.name: Awakened Awareness
perks.current_effect: While carrying a Survivor, reveals the Auras of other Survivors within 16/18/20 m of the Killer.
perks.plain_english_summary: While carrying someone, see nearby Survivors through walls.
activation_requirements: The Killer must be carrying a Survivor.
Other Survivors must be within 16/18/20 m.
deactivation_conditions: Aura reading ends when the Killer stops carrying a Survivor or the target leaves range.
duration: While carrying a Survivor; no Aura linger is listed for the live effect.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals other Survivors' Auras within 16/18/20 m while carrying a Survivor.
special_interactions: The live effect has no 2-second Aura linger; that linger was removed before the live 6.2.0 release.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Removed the 2-second Aura linger that was present in the PTB; the live range is 16/18/20 m while carrying.

perks.verification_notes: The official 6.2.0 live notes say the PTB Aura linger was removed; current values match the live effect.

perks.name: Bamboozle
perks.current_effect: Permanently increases the Killer's Window vault speed by 5/10/15%. Whenever the Killer vaults a Window, the Entity blocks it for Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: Vault Windows faster and temporarily block each vaulted Window for Survivors.
activation_requirements: The Killer must vault a Window to block it.
deactivation_conditions: The Window block ends after 8/12/16 seconds unless refreshed by vaulting the same Window.
Vaulting a different Window transfers the block effect to that Window.
duration: Window block: 8/12/16 seconds; vaulting that Window again resets the timer.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Only one Window block is active at a time; vaulting another Window transfers the effect.
special_interactions: Does not block a dropped Pallet when the Killer vaults it.
Does not increase vault speed when a Killer uses their Power to vault a Window.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: The current 5/10/15% vault-speed bonus and 8/12/16-second Window block are the launch effects; later wiki history entries describe a Pallet-vault clarification and an icon update.

perks.verification_notes: No later live numeric or functional balance change is listed in the current perk page. The 2.5.0 history entry is a description clarification; 9.5.1 updated the icon.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chilli
perks.current_effect: After hooking a Survivor, reveals the Auras of all Survivors at least 60/50/40 m from that Hook for 5 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: A Hook reveals Survivors who are far enough away from it.
activation_requirements: Hook a Survivor.
Each target must be at least 60/50/40 m away from the Hook, based on perk tier.
deactivation_conditions: Aura reveal ends after 5 seconds.
duration: 5 seconds after a Survivor is hooked.
perks.hook_interactions: Hooking a Survivor triggers the Aura reveal; distance is measured from that Hook.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals all Survivors outside the tier's distance threshold regardless of Health State, except Survivors in Lockers or protected from Aura reading.
special_interactions: Aura blockers and Lockers prevent the affected Survivors from being revealed.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Aura reveal duration increased from 4 to 5 seconds; the wiki attributes this to the earlier Hooking trigger and animation lock. No official note for this specific duration change was found.

perks.verification_notes: Current effect values come from the current perk page. Official 6.1.0 notes confirm the last documented rework (Bloodpoint bonus removed and distance made tiered); the wiki labels the later 7.1.0 duration increase undocumented, so that specific history is not independently confirmed by an official note.

perks.name: Batteries Included
perks.current_effect: While within 16 m of a completed Generator, grants 5% Haste; the effect lingers for 1/3/5 seconds after leaving range.
perks.plain_english_summary: Completed Generators provide a small speed boost when you are nearby.
activation_requirements: A completed Generator must be within 16 m of the Killer.
deactivation_conditions: Haste ends after leaving the Generator's 16 m range and then waiting the tier's 1/3/5-second linger.
duration: While within 16 m of a completed Generator, plus a 1/3/5-second linger after leaving range.
perks.generator_interactions: Completed Generators within 16 m are the source of the Haste effect.
special_interactions: The live perk is not disabled when Exit Gates are powered; the earlier live endgame restriction was removed in 7.4.2.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased range from 12 to 16 m and reverted Haste strength from 7% to 5%.

perks.verification_notes: The official 9.0.0 notes confirm current range and Haste values. The current wiki page confirms linger tiers and records the 7.4.2 removal of the powered-Exit-Gates restriction.

perks.name: Beast of Prey
perks.current_effect: Whenever the Killer triggers Bloodlust, grants Undetectable for 30/35/40 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: Gaining Bloodlust briefly hides your Terror Radius and Red Stain and blocks Aura reading of the Killer.
activation_requirements: The Killer must trigger the Bloodlust Status Effect.
deactivation_conditions: Undetectable ends after 30/35/40 seconds.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Undetectable suppresses Killer Aura reading while active.
special_interactions: The Undetectable duration can continue after Bloodlust ends.
Rapid Brutality disables Bloodlust and therefore prevents this perk from triggering.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Undetectable now lasts 30/35/40 seconds after Bloodlust triggers instead of only while Bloodlust is active; the Hunter-category Bloodpoint bonus was removed.

perks.verification_notes: The 8.5.0 official notes give the current duration and removal of the Bloodpoint effect. The current perk page confirms that the Undetectable window is time-limited after Bloodlust is lost.

perks.name: Bitter Murmur
perks.current_effect: Whenever a Generator is completed, reveals for 5 seconds the Auras of Survivors within 16 m of that Generator. When the last Generator is completed, reveals all Survivors' Auras for 5/7/10 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: Generator completions briefly reveal nearby Survivors; the final Generator reveals everyone.
activation_requirements: A Generator must be completed for the local Aura reveal.
The last Generator must be completed for the all-Survivor Aura reveal.
deactivation_conditions: The local reveal ends after 5 seconds.
The final-Generator reveal ends after 5/7/10 seconds.
duration: Final Generator all-Survivor Aura reveal: 5/7/10 seconds.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: The all-Survivor reveal occurs when the final Generator is completed; the local reveal applies on each Generator completion.
perks.generator_interactions: Generator completion triggers the local Aura reveal; completing the final Generator also triggers the all-Survivor reveal.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals Survivors' Auras near each completed Generator and all Survivor Auras on the final Generator completion.
special_interactions: The final Generator completion triggers the perk's all-Survivor reveal in addition to the standard completion trigger.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added a local reveal within 16 m of each completed Generator for 5 seconds; current final-Generator reveal is 5/7/10 seconds.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: Proposed local reveal increases from 16 m/5 seconds to 20 m/8 seconds, and the final-Generator reveal increases from 5/7/10 to 10/12/14 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The current wiki page displays 10.2.0 PTB values in its lead description; current_effect and tier values use its live-history values (16 m, 5 seconds, and 5/7/10 seconds). Official 10.2.0 PTB notes confirm the proposed change. The official 2.1.0 PTB notes document the original local-reveal mechanic; the current wiki history supplies the final live values.

perks.name: Blood Echo
perks.current_effect: Whenever you hook a Survivor, all Survivors in the Injured State suffer Exhausted and Haemorrhage for 20/25/30 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: Hooking one Survivor temporarily gives all injured Survivors two debuffs.
activation_requirements: Hook a Survivor.
A Survivor must be in the Injured State to receive the effects.
deactivation_conditions: Exhausted and Haemorrhage end after 20/25/30 seconds.
perks.hook_interactions: Hooking a Survivor triggers the effects on all Survivors who are Injured.
special_interactions: The live version has no cooldown; the 8.3.0 update removed it.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Removed the 80/70/60-second cooldown and changed the effect duration to 20/25/30 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The official 8.3.0 notes confirm the live duration and cooldown removal; the current page identifies the status effects as Exhausted and Haemorrhage.

perks.name: Blood Warden
perks.current_effect: Once at least one Exit Gate is opened, reveals the Auras of Survivors who are inside an Exit Gate. Once per Trial, hooking a Survivor while the perk is active blocks all opened Exit Gates for 40/50/60 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: After an Exit Gate opens, see Survivors inside gate areas; a Hook can then temporarily block opened gates once per Trial.
activation_requirements: At least one Exit Gate must be opened to activate the Aura-reading effect.
While active, hook a Survivor to trigger the Exit Gate block.
deactivation_conditions: The Exit Gate block ends after 40/50/60 seconds.
Aura reading applies only while Survivors are inside an Exit Gate after a gate has opened.
duration: Aura reading: while an eligible Survivor is inside an Exit Gate after a gate opens.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: The Exit Gate blocking effect can trigger once per Trial.
perks.hook_interactions: Hooking a Survivor while Blood Warden is active triggers the gate block; it does not require a specific hook type.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals Survivors' Auras while they are inside an Exit Gate after at least one gate has been opened.
special_interactions: Blocks all opened Exit Gates, preventing remaining Survivors from leaving through them during the block.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: The wiki reports Tier I gate-block duration increased from 30 to 40 seconds; the change's patch is unknown and no official note was located.

perks.verification_notes: Current values and the once-per-Trial limit come from the current perk page. Its history labels the Tier I increase from 30 to 40 seconds as undocumented and assigns no patch; this historical detail could not be verified against an official patch note. The 10.1.2 live bugfix also corrected a case where Survivor Auras were not revealed to the Killer while Blood Warden was equipped; this was a bugfix, not a documented balance change.

perks.name: Bloodhound
perks.current_effect: Pools of Blood left by Injured Survivors appear bright red and remain for 2/3/4 seconds longer.
perks.plain_english_summary: Blood trails are easier to see and last longer.
activation_requirements: An Injured Survivor must leave Pools of Blood.
deactivation_conditions: The additional Blood-pool lifetime is 2/3/4 seconds; pools then expire under the normal game rules.
duration: Adds 2/3/4 seconds to each affected Pool of Blood's lifetime.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Improves visual tracking of Pools of Blood; it does not reveal Auras.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Changed the blood-pool visibility effect to fixed bright red and clarified the description; the wiki lists this as the latest perk update.

perks.verification_notes: The current page confirms the live effect and lists 1.8.3 as its last change. No matching official 1.8.3 perk-note page was found in this research pass, so the historical version/change is wiki-supported rather than independently confirmed here.

perks.name: Brutal Strength
perks.current_effect: While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, increases Action speed by 10/15/20%.
perks.plain_english_summary: Break Pallets and Breakable Walls and damage Generators faster.
activation_requirements: The Killer must perform a Break action on a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or a Damage action on a Generator.
deactivation_conditions: The Action-speed bonus applies only during the relevant Break or Damage action.
duration: During each eligible Break or Damage action.
perks.generator_interactions: Increases the Action speed of damaging Generators by 10/15/20%.
perks.basic_attack_or_special_attack_restricti: The perk affects Break and Damage actions; it does not require an attack.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added Generator-damage speed to the existing 10/15/20% Break-action speed bonus; the current page lists the 3.6.0 Breakable Wall update as a description clarification.

perks.verification_notes: The current wiki page confirms the live eligible actions and 10/15/20% values. Official 2.1.0 PTB notes document the added Generator-damage effect; the final 2.1.0 patch notes confirm that update version, and the wiki history supplies the current effect wording.

perks.name: Call of Brine
perks.current_effect: After you perform the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Call of Brine affects it for 90 seconds: its regression speed becomes 130/140/150% of default, its Aura is highlighted yellow to you, and each Good Skill Check a Survivor succeeds while repairing it causes a Loud Noise Notification.
perks.plain_english_summary: Kick a Generator to make it regress faster and mark it; a Survivor succeeding a Good Skill Check on it alerts you.
activation_requirements: Perform the Damage Generator action on a Generator.
deactivation_conditions: The 90-second effect expires on that Generator.
perks.generator_interactions: Applies increased regression to the kicked Generator and gives a Loud Noise Notification when a Survivor succeeds a Good Skill Check while repairing it.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Highlights the affected Generator's Aura yellow to the Killer.
special_interactions: If another Perk causes the affected Generator to explode, its regression resumes at the Call of Brine speed it had reached before the explosion. When the duration expires, regression returns to the default speed.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased the effect duration from 70 to 90 seconds; the 130/140/150% regression values remained.

perks.verification_notes: Live values are recorded for build 10.1.2a as of 2026-10-04. Behaviour's 10.1.0 live notes support the 90-second duration; 10.1.2a has no perk balance change for this perk.

perks.name: Celestial Witness
perks.current_effect: Every 30 seconds, if the Obsession is at least 40 metres from you, you see their Aura for 2/2.5/3 seconds. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.
perks.plain_english_summary: Periodically tracks a distant Obsession or changes the Obsession to the farthest Survivor.
activation_requirements: Automatically checks the Obsession's distance every 30 seconds during the Trial.
At 40 metres or farther, reveals the Obsession's Aura; closer than 40 metres, changes the Obsession to the farthest Survivor.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals the Obsession's Aura when they are at least 40 metres away; otherwise assigns the Obsession to the farthest Survivor.
special_interactions: The distance check includes exactly 40 metres: at that boundary the Obsession's Aura is revealed. When the Obsession is closer than 40 metres, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added as one of The Judgment's Unique Perks.

perks.verification_notes: The 10.1.0 official live text says 'at least 40m'; exactly 40 metres qualifies for the Aura reveal. The live effect is unchanged in 10.1.2a. The linked secondary article resolves from the legacy Vigilance URL.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.current_effect: At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators farthest from you are blocked by the Entity for 80/100/120 seconds. The effect deactivates early when the first Survivor enters the Dying State.
perks.plain_english_summary: Temporarily blocks the three farthest Generators at the start, ending early on the first down.
activation_requirements: Automatically activates at the start of the Trial.
deactivation_conditions: The first Survivor enters the Dying State by any means.
The tier duration expires.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Deactivates permanently for the Trial when the first Survivor enters the Dying State.
perks.generator_interactions: The three Generators farthest from the Killer are blocked by the Entity.
special_interactions: The wiki records that a Survivor killed using Tombstone Piece or Judith's Tombstone also ends the effect.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added early deactivation when any Survivor enters the Dying State; it still expires after two minutes if no Survivor has entered that state.

perks.verification_notes: Live values are recorded for build 10.1.2a. The page's earlier history and current description agree on the three farthest Generators and the first-Dying-State deactivation.

perks.name: Coulrophobia
perks.current_effect: Survivors inside your Terror Radius heal 20/25/30% slower, and the pointer on their Healing Skill Checks rotates 50% faster.
perks.plain_english_summary: Slows healing and makes healing Skill Checks harder for Survivors inside your Terror Radius.
activation_requirements: Automatically affects Survivors inside your Terror Radius.
deactivation_conditions: The Survivor leaves your Terror Radius.
special_interactions: Snap Out of It is not a Healing action and is not affected by Coulrophobia.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced the healing-speed penalty to 20/25/30%; the 50% faster Healing Skill Check pointer remained.

perks.verification_notes: The 10.1.0 live patch notes verify the current values. No 10.1.2a perk change was found.

perks.name: Coup de Grâce
perks.current_effect: Whenever a Generator is completed, gain 2 Tokens, up to a maximum of 10 per Trial. Each Token increases the range of your next Lunge Attack by 70/75/80% and is consumed on use. You can hold at most 5 Tokens at once.
perks.plain_english_summary: Generator completions give charges that make a later Lunge Attack longer.
activation_requirements: A Generator is completed to gain Tokens.
Perform a Lunge Attack to consume one Token and increase its range.
deactivation_conditions: The increased range applies to one Lunge Attack and the consumed Token is spent.
perks.token_or_stack_behavior: Gain 2 Tokens per completed Generator; maximum 10 gained per Trial and 5 held at once; one Token is consumed per Lunge Attack.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Maximum 10 Tokens per Trial and 5 Tokens held at once.
perks.generator_interactions: Each completed Generator grants 2 Tokens.
perks.basic_attack_or_special_attack_restricti: The bonus is explicitly for a Lunge Attack; the perk page does not specify compatibility with each Killer's special attacks.
special_interactions: The 7.1.0 live notes also specify that Generators being worked on do not grant extra Tokens when the last Generator is completed.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Changed the perk to grant 2 Tokens per completed Generator, up to 10 per Trial, with 5 held at once.

perks.verification_notes: The live 7.1.0 notes confirm the token change. The 10.1.2a live value is unchanged.

perks.name: Cruel Limits
perks.current_effect: Whenever a Generator is completed, all Windows are blocked for all Survivors for 20/25/30 seconds. The Auras of the blocked Windows are highlighted yellow to you.
perks.plain_english_summary: A completed Generator temporarily blocks every Window for Survivors and shows you which Windows are blocked.
activation_requirements: A Generator is completed.
deactivation_conditions: The tier duration expires.
duration: 20/25/30 seconds after a Generator is completed
perks.generator_interactions: Generator completion activates the effect.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: The Auras of blocked Windows are highlighted yellow to the Killer.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Removed the 32-metre limit so the perk blocks all Windows across the map.

perks.verification_notes: Cruel Limits returned with Stranger Things and is again a Unique Perk; the global Window-blocking effect is the live 7.1.0 change. The 10.1.2a value is unchanged.

perks.name: Cull the Weak
perks.current_effect: Each time you hook a Survivor other than the Obsession, gain 1 Token. While the Obsession is alive, each Token reduces all other Survivors' Repairing, Healing, and Sabotaging speeds by 2/2.5/3%, up to 22/27.5/33% at 11 Tokens. The Obsession is unaffected by the penalty and has a permanent 33% Action Speed bonus to Unhooking and Healing other Survivors.
perks.plain_english_summary: Hooking non-Obsession Survivors slows the other Survivors' actions while giving the Obsession faster healing and unhooking.
activation_requirements: Hook a Survivor who is not the Obsession.
deactivation_conditions: The slowdown and Obsession bonus only apply while the Obsession is alive.
duration: The effects persist while the Obsession is alive.
perks.token_or_stack_behavior: Gain 1 Token per non-Obsession hook. Each Token adds the tier-specific penalty; maximum 11 Tokens.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Maximum 11 Tokens; reaching 11 requires an Obsession change before the ninth hook.
perks.generator_interactions: Reduces Repairing speed for every Survivor except the living Obsession.
perks.hook_interactions: Gain 1 Token when hooking a Survivor other than the Obsession.
special_interactions: The perk can only reach 11 Tokens if the Obsession changes before the ninth hook; the wiki notes this maximum is unlikely to matter in a normal Trial.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reworked the former Dying Light effect to gain Tokens from hooking non-Obsession Survivors while the Obsession lives.

perks.verification_notes: For players without The Shape, this is the General Perk name introduced in 9.4.0. Its mechanics are the former Dying Light effect, last reworked in 3.2.0. The 10.1.2a value is unchanged.

perks.name: Dark Arrogance
perks.current_effect: While vaulting a Window, your Vaulting speed increases by 15/20/25%. Whenever you are Pallet-stunned or blinded, your Pallet-stun recovery speed is reduced by 15% and the duration of Killer Blinds is increased by 15%.
perks.plain_english_summary: Vault Windows faster, at the cost of longer Pallet stuns and blinds.
activation_requirements: Vault a Window to receive the Vaulting speed bonus.
Be Pallet-stunned or blinded for the penalties to apply.
deactivation_conditions: The Vaulting bonus applies while vaulting; stun and blind penalties apply when those events occur.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced the Pallet-stun and Killer-blind duration penalties from 25% to 15%.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: Proposes 15/20/25% faster basic-attack recovery while vaulting and increases the blind and Pallet-stun penalties from 15% to 25%. These PTB values are not live in 10.1.2a.

perks.verification_notes: The current wiki article displays 10.2.0 PTB text. Live 10.1.2a values are taken from the prior live entry and Behaviour's 9.2.0 release notes; the PTB proposal is recorded separately.

perks.name: Dark Devotion
perks.current_effect: Whenever the Obsession becomes injured by any means, Dark Devotion activates for 35/40/45 seconds, transfers your 40-metre Terror Radius to the Obsession, and grants you Undetectable.
perks.plain_english_summary: When the Obsession is injured, your Terror Radius moves to them while you become Undetectable.
activation_requirements: The Obsession loses a Health State by any means.
deactivation_conditions: The activation duration expires.
The Obsession changes or is killed.
Unforeseen is activated while Dark Devotion is active.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Requires an Obsession; only one Survivor can be the Obsession at a time.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Transfers the Killer's Terror Radius to the Obsession; the transferred Terror Radius is 40 metres.
perks.basic_attack_or_special_attack_restricti: Any damage that injures the Obsession qualifies; a Basic Attack is not required.
special_interactions: The Obsession hears the transferred Terror Radius and counts as inside it for effects that check Terror Radius. Terror-Radius powers such as the Doctor's Static Blast can originate from the Obsession while this effect is active.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased the effect duration to 35/40/45 seconds and transferred Terror Radius to 40 metres.

perks.verification_notes: Current live values reflect the 9.0.0 buff and the 6.1.0 change allowing any injury source. No 10.1.2a perk change was found.

perks.name: Darkness Revealed
perks.current_effect: When you search a Locker, the Auras of Survivors within 8 metres of any Locker are revealed to you for 6/7/8 seconds. Darkness Revealed has a 30-second cooldown.
perks.plain_english_summary: Searching a Locker reveals Survivors who are near any Locker.
activation_requirements: Complete a Locker Search action.
deactivation_conditions: The Aura reveal expires after 6/7/8 seconds.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Cannot reactivate during its 30-second cooldown.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reveals Survivors within 8 metres of any Locker; the Aura duration begins when the Locker Search action completes.
special_interactions: Survivors hiding inside Lockers are shielded from the Aura reveal. Finding and grabbing a Survivor from a Locker triggers the reveal when that interaction finishes.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased the Aura-reveal duration from 3/4/5 to 6/7/8 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The 8.1.0 live patch notes verify the current Aura duration. No 10.1.2a perk change was found.

perks.name: Dead Man's Switch

After the hook, a Survivor stops repairing a Generator; the first such Generator is blocked.
The 50-second cooldown must have ended since the prior activation.
deactivation_conditions: The Generator block ends after 25/30/35 seconds.
A 50-second cooldown prevents another activation after the perk triggers.

perks.generator_interactions: After a hook, the first Generator a Survivor stops repairing is blocked by the Entity for 25/30/35 seconds and highlighted white to the Killer. The cooldown is 50 seconds.
perks.hook_interactions: Hooking any Survivor creates the opportunity for the first subsequent Survivor who stops repairing a Generator to trigger the block, subject to the 50-second cooldown.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: The blocked Generator is highlighted white to the Killer.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced the Generator block duration to 25/30/35 seconds from 40/45/50 seconds.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: Proposes that the first Generator a Survivor stops repairing for more than 2 seconds after a hook is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds, with a separate 30/35/40-second cooldown. This is not live in 10.1.2a.

The linked secondary Killer Perks listing currently displays PTB values and was not used for live verification. No secondary URL is retained for current mechanics because the available per-perk wiki/stat pages conflict with BHVR's explicit 50-second live cooldown comparison.

perks.name: Deadlock
perks.current_effect: Each time a Generator is completed, Deadlock blocks the Generator with the most progression for 15/20/25 seconds. The Aura of the blocked Generator is highlighted white to you.
perks.plain_english_summary: Whenever a Generator is finished, Deadlock temporarily blocks the Generator with the most progress and shows you its Aura.
activation_requirements: A Generator is completed.
deactivation_conditions: The Generator-blocking effect ends when its tier duration expires.

perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Highlights the Aura of the blocked Generator white to the Killer.

The wiki's current perk history clarifies the ownership split: owners of CHAPTER 21 retain Deadlock as The Cenobite's Unique Perk under its original name, while other players receive No Holds Barred as a General Perk. The two names are listed with identical live mechanics; this object captures the owner-retained Deadlock name. Its current 15/20/25-second values reflect the 8.0.0 live balance change.

perks.name: Deathbound
perks.current_effect: When a Survivor finishes healing another Survivor for the equivalent of 1 Health State, the Healer screams and reveals their location, suffers from Oblivious whenever farther than 12/8/4 metres from the Healed Survivor, and sees that Survivor's Aura while Deathbound is active. The effect deactivates after the Healer loses a Health State.

deactivation_conditions: Deathbound deactivates when the Healer loses a Health State.
duration: Oblivious and Aura effects remain until the Healer loses a Health State.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: The Healer sees the Aura of the Survivor they healed while Deathbound is active; the Healer also screams and reveals their location on activation.

perks.verification_notes: The 8.6.0 live notes verify the current distance thresholds. The additional Aura reveal is recorded in the current wiki change log as undocumented; it is included because it appears in the current perk description.

perks.name: Deerstalker
perks.current_effect: Whenever a Survivor reads your Aura through an Aura-reading effect with a fixed duration, Deerstalker reveals that Survivor's Aura to you for the same duration. Also, every 40/35/30 seconds, your Aura is revealed to the Survivor with the lowest cumulative Chase time for 3 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: When a Survivor sees your Aura, you can see theirs; periodically, the least-chased Survivor sees your Aura.
activation_requirements: A Survivor reads your Aura through a fixed-duration Aura-reading effect.
Automatically triggers every 40/35/30 seconds.
deactivation_conditions: Each Aura reveal ends when its corresponding Aura-reading duration ends; the automatic reveal lasts 3 seconds.
duration: Automatic Aura reveal to Survivor: 3 seconds
Reciprocal reveal: same duration as the Survivor's fixed-duration Aura-reading effect
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Automatic reveal repeats every 40/35/30 seconds.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Reciprocally reveals the Aura of a Survivor reading the Killer's Aura; periodically reveals the Killer's Aura to the Survivor with the lowest cumulative Chase time.
special_interactions: The reciprocal effect only works with fixed-duration Aura reveals, not conditional Aura reveals. The Lich's Magic Items can trigger it when they reveal his Aura, except Skyguard for Fly, which is conditional.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reworked from revealing Dying Survivors to reciprocally revealing the Aura of a Survivor who reads the Killer's Aura and periodically showing the Killer's Aura to the least-chased Survivor.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: Proposes increasing the automatic Killer-Aura reveal to 4 seconds from 3 seconds. The 3-second value remains live in 10.1.2a.

perks.name: Discordance
perks.current_effect: A Generator within 64/96/128 metres being repaired by at least 2 Survivors is marked with a yellow Aura. The first time it is highlighted, it triggers a Loud Noise Notification. The Aura lingers for 4 seconds after the Generator leaves range or only 1 Survivor remains repairing it.

deactivation_conditions: The Aura stops being highlighted when the Generator leaves range or only 1 Survivor remains, then lingers for 4 seconds.
duration: Aura lingers for 4 seconds after the activation condition ends.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: No Trial limit; each Generator can trigger while the activation condition is met.
perks.generator_interactions: Detects a Generator within tier range while at least 2 Survivors repair it.
perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: Marks qualifying Generator Auras yellow and causes a Loud Noise Notification the first time a Generator is highlighted.
special_interactions: When used by The Nemesis, Zombies immediately pursue the Generator when Discordance activates, regardless of the Zombies' distance from it.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Changed the detection ranges to 64/96/128 metres and reduced Aura linger from 8 to 4 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The 4.3.2 live notes verify the tier ranges and 4-second linger. No 10.1.2a perk change was found.

perks.name: Dissolution
perks.current_effect: Three seconds after you injure a Survivor by any means, Dissolution activates for 12/16/20 seconds. Wait 3 seconds for the effect to activate.
Any Survivor must fast-vault a Pallet while inside your Terror Radius during the active window to trigger the break.
deactivation_conditions: The active duration expires.
Any Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet inside your Terror Radius and it breaks.

The qualifying Pallet vault must occur inside the Killer's Terror Radius; a vault outside it does not trigger the break.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Introduced with a 3-second delay, 12/16/20-second active window, and Pallet break on a qualifying fast vault.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: Proposes requiring Basic-Attack damage to activate and changing the active duration from 12/16/20 seconds to 13/14/15 seconds. The Pallet-break trigger remains the next Survivor to fast-vault a Pallet inside the Killer’s Terror Radius; this part is not a new PTB change. These proposed values are not live in 10.1.2a.

The 10.2.0 PTB changes the damage type and duration, not the vaulting-Survivor trigger; the linked secondary Killer Perks page has displayed PTB values and an unsupported Aura reveal, so it was not used for live verification. The stale wiki page that displayed 10.2.0 PTB values and an unsupported Aura reveal was removed from secondary_source_urls; NightLight's current live text was used as the secondary reference.

activation_requirements: Always active.

perks.verification_notes: The current wiki page displays 10.2.0 PTB text. Live 10.1.2a is the Terror Radius increase only; the 8.4.0 live notes verify its tier values.

perks.name: Dominance

perks.verification_notes: The live 8.4.0 notes verify the 8/12/16-second value. The wiki page also displays upcoming 10.2.0 PTB text; live Chests-and-Totems behavior is retained here.

perks.current_effect: After you perform the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Dragon's Grip activates on it for 30 seconds. The first Survivor to interact with it screams and reveals their location for 4 seconds and becomes Exposed for 60 seconds. Cooldown: 60/45/30 seconds.

deactivation_conditions: The 30-second activation window expires.

perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: The Survivor screams and reveals their location for 4 seconds.

perks.generator_interactions: Reduces Repairing speed for every Survivor except the living Obsession.
perks.hook_interactions: Gain 1 Token when hooking a Survivor other than the Obsession.

deactivation_conditions: The effect does not apply while carrying a Survivor.
duration: Reduces the Pallet stun duration when triggered.

perks.name: Eruption

perks.plain_english_summary: Kick Generators to mark them; downing any Survivor then regresses every marked Generator and reveals its current repairers.

A Survivor enters the Dying State by any means.
deactivation_conditions: After the effect triggers, marked Generator Auras are cleared and the 30-second cooldown begins.

I used Behaviour's 6.6.0 live rework notes for the current effect and excluded the old Incapacitated effect. The 9.2.0 change to 5% was PTB-only and is excluded; live remains 10% of total progress.

activation_requirements: A Hex Totem lights at the start of the Trial.
Hit a Survivor with a Basic or Special Attack.
deactivation_conditions: Blindness ends when the Hex Totem is cleansed or blessed.
The perk tracks only the most recent 2/3/4 Survivors hit.

Survivors attempt to Bless or Cleanse a Totem.
deactivation_conditions: Lose 1 Token whenever any Totem is cleansed.
The Hex effect ends if its own Hex Totem is cleansed or blessed.

perks.name: Hex: Two Can Play

duration: Blindness caused to a triggering Survivor: 1.5 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The trigger accepts either a stun or a blind by a Survivor; it does not require a pallet stun.

perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: When a running Survivor within 32 metres gains Haste, you receive a location alert. This is not an Aura reveal.

perks.aura_or_tracking_interactions: The Obsession sees the Hex Totem's Aura within 12 metres.

perks.verification_notes: Current perk text confirmed; no later live balance change identified.
